purpose: Adjudicate the 33-task full-3D and theory-expansion roadmap without erasing the prior radial negative result or authorizing a real-data campaign whose source and theory gates remain closed.

tasks.result: The 147-object radial campaign remains closed with zero survivors and append-only counterexamples.
A common source-only full-3D geometry, boundary, uncertainty, and anti-leakage contract is frozen.
The 420 by 147 dimensionality matrix is frozen; zero current real objects are full-3D ready.
Independent target-free Newton, AQUAL, and QUMOND Cartesian solvers pass analytic, invariance, EFE, and convergence tests.
NFW, Burkert, Einasto, weak-field MOG, and refracted-gravity mechanics exist; EMOND, full covariant MOG/RG, Penner, and a published nonlocal solver remain blocked.
Manufactured, residual, resolution, rotation, and cross-solver checks pass for implemented equations; two independent production routes do not yet exist for every comparator.
The local GP01 multiplier is confirmed as a generic-3D nonconservative control and a high-symmetry known-family behavior.
A conservative full-3D GP01 elliptic solver passes boundedness, ellipticity, curl, rotation, saddle, EFE, and PDE residual tests; global existence and uniqueness are not proved.
T1 and T2 still lack unique routes through nulls, saddles, separatrices, closed lines, and multiple anchors.
The finite-box screened spatial PDE and zero-length limit pass; an invariant general kernel and distinct real-data discriminator remain missing.
A bounded telegraph control exhibits damping and persistence with c_Gamma<=c, but still uses an instantaneous Poisson source and a preferred slice.
The action seed retains singular or nonanalytic high-field behavior and incomplete Hamiltonian and hyperbolicity health.
All 420 registered concepts are routed through 25 applicable theory gates, producing 10,500 deterministic rows.
Dimensions, limits, field, source, operator, symmetry, action, causal, stability, sector, source, and campaign gates are routed; most concepts still lack definitions needed to execute every gate.
Thirteen gravity/light/quantum cards and 12 bounded probes pass; seven quantum-consistency gates remain required-unrun and the wildcard is quarantined.
No candidate derives irreversible capture because no energy, momentum, and entropy receiver or byproduct ledger exists.
A 26-fixture common synthetic universe covers compact sources, disks, environments, histories, rays, clocks, waves, and corrupted controls.
All six currently executable full-3D mechanisms recover their injected signatures, retain the null, pass invariance, and are distinguishable on a nonspherical fixture.
A universal conformal matter-source identity exists, but no physical source profile or on-shell 3-D background is derived.
The restricted conformal null cone is consistent; lensing, metric backreaction, and both metric potentials are not completed.
Static clock/redshift comparisons correctly depend on endpoints, not path length; dynamic integrated redshift and source history remain blocked.
Necessary tensor/photon cone conditions and a severe disformal bound exist; generation, damping, polarizations, binary loss, and full characteristics remain incomplete.
Solar/GW necessary conditions and exact flat-FLRW background equations exist; Solar, laboratory, pulsar, perturbation, BBN, CMB, growth, and strong-field passes remain blocked.
The response-independent galaxy full-3D source acquisition requirements are frozen for all 139 objects.
The response-independent cluster imaging, stellar, member, geometry, and environment requirements are frozen for all eight objects.
Environment labels, continuous fields, matched covariates, history fields, and seven negative controls are frozen; the actual independent ledger is not available.
Eligibility is adjudicated honestly: no current real object and theory pair satisfies full-3D source and multisector prerequisites.
No real-data manifest was frozen because Task 27 produced zero eligible entries.
No target-blind 3-D pilot was run.
No object-by-object real 3-D development scoring was run.
No matched-environment response discriminator was run because its source ledger is absent.
No unchanged real cross-scale or cross-sector transfer was attempted.
The roadmap stopped at the preregistered source and theory gate; zero survivors remains valid and no repair campaign was auto-created.

next_decision.reason: No current object has an honest full-3D source and no candidate has complete matter-light-clock-GW-cosmology closure.
highest_value_next_work: acquire or construct independently justified source-side 3-D imaging and geometry for a small pilot sample
build the environment ledger before any history hypothesis is scored
complete one healthy common action or keep GP01 explicitly phenomenological
implement the remaining strongest published full-3D comparators
run quantum and wave candidates only against observables unique to those ontologies

establishes: a completed theory-first and synthetic first pass
an honest full-3D source-blocked stopping point
